Class Picture

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.holograms.api.Picture
public final class Picture extends Object
A picture for a hologram: a PNG, JPG, BMP or GIF (animated GIFs keep their frames and timing), read with limits so a file can never take the server's memory or time: at most MAX_FILE_BYTES, MAX_SIDE pixels a side, MAX_PIXELS pixels and MAX_FRAMES frames. Only the pixels are kept (anything else in the file is dropped), already made smaller to STILL_SIDE pixels a side (FRAME_SIDE for an animation's frames). Immutable; any thread. Shown with Holograms.picture(String, String, Vector3d, Picture, float, TextImage.PictureFrame, int, boolean). Since API_VERSION 5.

    • slideshow

      public static Picture slideshow(List<Picture> pictures, int msEach)
      A slideshow: the first frame of each picture, in turn, each showing for msEach milliseconds (1 to 600 seconds), all on one canvas the size of the biggest, smaller ones in its middle. It plays like an animated GIF (so in the Pro edition; the free one shows the first). Since API_VERSION 5.
